summary: The agent successfully created an Excel-based warehouse load plan but had to retry due to data parsing issues with header rows in Excel files. The skill captures the reusable pattern for reading multi-sheet Excel data with irregular headers, performing supply chain calculations (days on hand, out-of-stock projections, inbound/outbound matching), and generating structured output workbooks. Key lessons: always inspect raw Excel structure before assuming header positions, validate date parsing explicitly, and separate data reading from calculation logic for easier debugging.
